meta.title: Misprint — a risograph studio, with its own CSS
meta.description: A risograph studio and zine library built by gogh, wearing a stylesheet of its own: misregistered pink-and-blue headlines, photographs pulled as halftone duotones, overprinting ink circles, prints that straighten on hover, a spinning sticker and an endless ticker.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
